summary: You run six real questions through the pipeline, read the answers like a user and label them good, wrong or doubtful. You find three kinds of failure (wrong page with confidence, answered when it should refuse, refused when it could help), see that one setting trades one failure for another, and write a plan of three failure types with ways to detect them.
goal: List 3 ways your assistant can fail.

items.text: Add failure_probe.py, run it and label each of the six answers good, wrong or doubtful
Add three questions of your own and predict which will fail
Change min_score to 0.5 and 0.7 and predict which answers change
Write notes/failures.md: three failure types with a real example and how a script could detect each
Commit the probe and the notes
Play the Failure Finder game to the end and see your score
